anomalies.observed: The LM1117-5.0 regulator U1 has both its input pin (VI, pin 2) and its output pin (VO, pin 3) connected to the +5V net (two '+5V' arrows on either side of U1, page 2 / column 6). The unregulated supply net VCC — which carries the input decoupling capacitor C1 (100 nF, page 1) and the power input J5 — is not connected to U1 at all.
anomalies.expected: For a self-powered ATtiny fan controller, the 5 V logic rail must be derived from the board's input supply: U1.VIN (pin 2) should sit on VCC (the same net as C1 and J5), and U1.VOUT (pin 3) on +5V. Tying VIN to VOUT bridges the regulator's input to its own output and leaves the +5V rail with no source from the board's power input.

evidence.quote: U1 LM1117-5.0: pin1 GND->GND, pin2 VI->+5V, pin3 VO->+5V; C2 100nF on +5V; C1 100nF on VCC (not on U1)
J5 PWR pin2 = VCC; VCC net also feeds C1, R6, JP1 — VCC never reaches U1

anomalies.impact: When the board is powered from its own supply (J5/VCC), the +5V logic rail is never generated, so U2/U3 and the I2C/ISP/programmer rails are unpowered and the controller does not run; the LM1117 is effectively wired input-to-output (shorted).

anomalies.observed: The two MCU symbols, marked as the THT footprint (U2, ATtiny45-20P) and the SMD footprint (U3, ATtiny13V-10S) of the same board position, disagree on pin assignment: U2 pin 2 = POT, pin 3 = TACH, whereas U3 pin 2 = TACH, pin 3 = POT.
anomalies.expected: Alternative THT/SMD footprints for the same logical device must carry the same net on the same pin number so that either variant is drop-in interchangeable; here the potentiometer and tachometer signals are swapped between the two variants.

evidence.quote: U2 (THT): 5 SDA, 6 PWM, 7 SCK, 2 POT, 3 TACH, 1 RST
U3 (SMD): 5 SDA, 6 PWM, 7 SCK, 3 POT, 2 TACH, 1 RST

anomalies.impact: If the SMD variant (U3) is populated, the ADC/tach inputs are transposed relative to the THT variant: the firmware reads the potentiometer on the tach pin and the tach pulses on the pot pin, corrupting fan-speed control and RPM sensing.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains a power-rail misconnection: the LM1117-5.0 (U1) has its input and output both tied to +5V while the raw supply VCC (with its input cap C1 and power connector J5) is never connected to it, so the 5V logic rail is not generated from the board's own supply; additionally the THT and SMD MCU footprints (U2/U3) disagree on the POT/TACH pin assignment, making the two build variants non-interchangeable.
